donor_subject: Radar durable routing telemetry and heartbeat semantics
adapted_mechanisms: coordination health should expose outcome counts rather than only raw records
health readout must be derived from durable evidence
missed or unresolved operational state must remain visible
vera_specific_changes: no second telemetry database is created
all counts are derived from the integrity-checked coordination command journal
unresolved command bindings are surfaced explicitly
confirmed writes and result classes are diagnostic only
no heartbeat scheduler or sink is installed
authority_rule: health projection is read-only diagnostic evidence and grants no routing, retry, provider, action, or protected-effect authority
